title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the connector-governance guidance omits that ACP-only mode disables classic data policies, including rules for custom and HTTP connectors. The agent-node behaviour, credit controls and roadmap facts are supported; the roadmap citation also needs correcting.
